newsitem.title: Mexico: Quake registers 7.3 on Richter scale in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Quake registers 7.3 on Richter scale in Mexico.

text.p: A strong earthquake that reportedly measured 7.3 on the Richter scale rocked western and central Mexico on Saturday afternoon, although there were no immediate reports of injuries or damage.
Mexican radio station Radio Red quoted the National Earthquake Centre as saying the quake measured 7.3 on the Richter scale and was centred off the western state of Michoacan.

The quake shook Mexico City at around 2:30 p.m. (2030 GMT) and was felt all over the city, sending some small objects falling from shelves in houses and causing panicked residents to run into the streets.
Radio reports said the tremor had also been felt across western Mexico, especially in Mexico's second city of Guadalajara.
Traffic lights were knocked out in much of Mexico City, causing gnarled traffic in some sections of the city. Electricity and telephones appeared to be working normally.
